matches.note: The card's own text: the two "continued to battle all through the evening and all through the Topeka Civic Center" after the referee's own three-count in their opening match -- no further resolution is given, left unresolved rather than guessed.

Second of two Great Plains Heavyweight Championship defenses this night, against the #1 contender -- Chef retained.
DQ win for Time Stands Still.

notes: Recovered from the Topeka Tabloid's own card recap inside the regional-news document ("GPWA TEARS UP TOPEKA - ANGRY CHEF RETAINS TITLE"), not a dedicated card-summaries page -- the fed's own text never gives this house show a brand name (unlike "On The Road"/"Small Package"/"Slamfest"), so none is invented here. The same date's own Topeka Review article ("WRESTLING PROMOTION SPARKS PROTEST") independently confirms the same show, city and venue from the protest side of the story.
